news.title: Ken Griffin Says AI ‘Almost Certainly’ in a Bubble Right Now
news.summary: Billionaire Ken Griffin said investors are “almost certainly” in the midst of an artificial intelligence bubble as many companies are still grappling with just how much they’ll spend on the technology and how it will transform the economy.

news.title: Judge Reluctant to Set Rates in Qualcomm-Arm Licensing Talks
news.summary: A federal judge weighing an antitrust claim against Arm Holdings Plc expressed reluctance to get involved in setting licensing fees that Qualcomm Inc. would have to pay Arm for using new technology needed to design the next generation of chips for computers, phones, vehicles and data centers.

news.title: Musk Gave Order to Slow Down Ukraine’s Starlink, WSJ Reports
news.summary: A recent slowdown of the SpaceX’s Starlink satellite system that enables Ukraine to fend off deadly Russian aerial assaults came from an order by Elon Musk, the company’s chief executive officer, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.

news.summary: Detavio Samuels, CEO of Offscript Worldwide, says YouTube is a powerful discovery and audience-building platform, but creators can expand into other businesses and distribution channels. news.title: Musk Says ASML and Others Are Expediting Chipmaking Gear for Terafab
news.summary: ASML Holding NV and other key providers of chipmaking machines have expedited supplies for Tesla Inc. and SpaceX’s Terafab, Elon Musk said, signaling that the billionaire is making fast progress on an ambitious semiconductor project.

news.title: Ken Griffin Says AI Presents 'Golden Era' for Entrepreneurs
news.summary: Citadel founder and CEO Ken Griffin says AI’s rapid development brings a mix of concern and opportunity. He argues that workers in roles especially exposed to AI will need substantial reskilling. He speaks with Bloomberg's Dani Burger at Citadel's annual Future of Global Markets Conference in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Super Micro Jumps After Preliminary Results Top Estimates

news.title: Anthropic S1 Shows $80 Billion Loss This Year, WSJ Reports
